title: Sociotechnic planner output
$comment: Local output contract. src/plan.ts owns semantic checks and runtime escape eligibility. Extra object fields remain allowed. No remote schema lookup is needed.

description.description: Small executable task: what changes and where; no unanswered human decision as an implementation stage.

files.description: Repository-relative files; mark new files in the description. COMMENTS requires nonempty, exact, disjoint file lists.

acceptance.description: Observable results and their independent evidence.

title.description: Trimmed UTF-16 length 3..80; enforced by the engine.

tier.description: EASY: localized existing pattern within the brief's file limit. BULK: mechanical repetition. COMMENTS: explicit comment/docblock cleanup, behavior unchanged. COMPLEX: new abstractions, cross-module work, concurrency, auth/security, migrations, unclear requirements or over the EASY file limit.

tierReason.description: Choose the cheapest tier that honestly fits; count tests and docs too.

touches.description: Every file/glob the build may change, including tests and docs.

docsImpact.description: Assess contracts, commands, config/defaults, behavior and navigation; include affected docs in stages/touches. Explain no impact.

testing.description: Relevant behavior/integration and negative cases; name inputs and expected results. Reuse the repository's checks.

designDigest.description: Exact approved design digest when the brief supplies one.

reason.description: Trimmed length at least10, raw length at most500. Unique agent names; recommendation does not reassign a run.

x-engine-checks: String validation uses trim(); docsImpact.note may be empty.
COMMENTS files cannot be absolute, contain backslashes or empty/dot/parent segments, or overlap across stages. Preserve executable directives and public contracts; no application refactors.
Agent recommendations use unique registered names; roster, role compatibility and locks are engine validated.

questions: Which existing module owns this behavior?

x-engine-checks: Allowed once per run and only when the brief permits it.
If advisors is present, supply one name/null per question. Only compatible research-template roster agents; respect locked assignments. No onward delegation.

questions: Should this deliver a review report or an implementation?

items.description: A specific human decision; raw UTF-16 length at most4000.

x-engine-checks: Available after research too; never send unanswered human decisions to the builder.
The engine binds answers to this dispatch and resumes a fresh planner; answers do not approve the plan or authorize a build.

examples.reason: Design the requested new dashboard with the human before implementation.

reason.description: Specific assignment; raw UTF-16 length at most4000.

x-engine-checks: Use only when permitted for new/substantial UI work or a specific follow-up. Returned artifacts and human approval remain binding.

stages.title: Update behavior
stages.description: Update src/x.ts using the existing pattern.
acceptance: The changed behavior meets the criterion.
